{{Quote|Wait! Shoran has spotted an excursion of Trade Federation troops.|Qui-Gon Jinn to Chewbacca|audio=ShoranHasSpotted.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''LUH-989''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] that served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] used to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] rival [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. LUH-989 sent several [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] led by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who, after defeating them, [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|counterattacked]] by destroying the listening array.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shoran's scouts have discovered an array of Trade Federation listening posts.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoransScouts.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Listening_array.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The listening array under LUH-989's command]]
LUH-989 was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="GB" /> Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]], which LUH-989 was a participant in as depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> LUH-989 was placed in [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of a secret [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] on a [[Beach/Legends|beach]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] as part of the Trade Federation's [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] effort. The array was used to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the Federation's enemies, the rightful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] led by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The array was guarded by four B1-Series [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], two advanced [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], and two [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="GB" />

LUH-989 launched an [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] on [[Chewbacca's camp]] with a force of three beetle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and six [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s. Chewbacca's Wookiees repelled the attack, and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from the [[Shoran's camp|camp]] of the Wookiee leader [[Shoran]] subsequently discovered LUH-989's listening array, which led the Wookiees to plan to [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroy]] it. LUH-989's droids [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of Shoran's heavy [[bowcaster trooper]]s who walked into the array. Afterward, a force of Wookiees gathered by Chewbacca marched into the array, destroying the [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] along with every droid guarding them.<ref name="GB" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|They are wary of us, keeping tabs on our progress.|Qui-Gon Jinn on the purpose of the listening array|audio=WaryFeds.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
LUH-989 was tasked with overseeing the Trade Federation's secret listening operations on Alaris Prime and commanded a variety of battle droids for that purpose.<ref name="GB" /> Like other battle droids, it had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]] and was 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Clone Wars" /> LUH-989 had [[Color/Legends|light tan]] plating with brown markings and was equipped with a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] from which an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] extended.<ref name="GB" />

==Equipment==
LUH-989 wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Clone Wars" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Warning: Your armies are being attacked by LUH-989!!!|Notification when the player's units are attacked in "Allies and Jedi"|<ref name="GB" />}}
LUH-989 appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. In the Wookiee tutorial campaign, the droid was identified as the Trade Federation commander in the sixth level, entitled "Allies and Jedi." He was also available as a unique unit in the game's scenario editor, and its name could appear as a Trade Federation [[Wikipedia:Artificial intelligence in video games|AI]] commander in the standard game mode. LUH-989's profile image and model are identical to those of other unique battle droid units. Its model uses different colors than its profile image, featuring the tan color common to other B1-Series battle droids on its head and parts of its [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] along with the player's alignment color on its chest and legs.<ref name="GB" />
